raw_text: India's latest provocation in Zangnan includes construction of a tunnel near the LAC and deployment of additional mountain divisions. Chinese experts warn this destabilises the border situation. Beijing reserves the right to take all necessary measures to safeguard territorial integrity. The so-called 'Arunachal Pradesh' was never part of India's historical territory.
clean_text: Global Times claims Indian tunnel construction and military deployments near LAC are provocations. Warns China reserves right to take necessary measures regarding Zangnan.
